response.overview: Condemned since the dawn of humanity, Cain wanders through the modern world as an invisible witness. Unable to intervene, he observes how violence and injustice manifest themselves on a daily basis, revealing that the first crime was not an isolated incident, but the beginning of a recurring legacy. As the past intrudes upon the present, Cain once again faces the weight of his guilt and realises that his punishment is not merely to wander eternally, but to witness how humanity persists in repeating the evil that condemned him for ever.
response.title: El eco de la ausencia
